description.value: Mariners Market & Espresso Bar is a convenience store and espresso bar operated by Maple Bay Marina on Genoa Bay Road near Duncan. Sitting within a marina complex on the shores of Maple Bay, it is positioned to serve both boaters and cyclists exploring this quiet coastal side road south of Duncan. The espresso bar component makes it a natural refreshment stop for those on the Cowichan Valley's back roads.
